CITY OF SAN MARINO DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA Christa Lakon, Chair www.cityofsanmarino.org Sharon Mequet, Vice Chair (626) 300­0700 Phone Raymond Cheng, Member San Marino City Hall Rick Chou, Member 2200 Huntington Drive Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij, Member San Marino, CA 91108 REGULAR MEETING OF THE DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE WEDNESDAY, MARCH 01, 2023 AT 6:00 PM BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY 1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE SAN MARINO, CA 91108 The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community. Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City at (626) 300­0713 or at planning@cityofsanmarino.org at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible. How to participate in the meeting from home: Via Computer for Video Streaming: Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5719496876 Meeting ID: 571 949 6876 How to offer public comment from home: 1. Public comment will be accepted by email to Planning@CityofSanMarino.org before or during the meeting prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. 2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the meeting. CALL TO ORDER PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE ROLL CALL Alternate Suzanne Torgeson, Member Raymond Cheng, Member Rick Chou, Member Joyce Garsoulis­Batnij, Vice Chair Sharon Mequet, Chair Christa Lakon POSTING OF AGENDA The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website: http://www.CityofSanMarino.org. PUBLIC COMMENTS The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Community Development Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design Review Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design Review Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items. PUBLIC HEARINGS 1. CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVEW CASE NO.
